snippet.title: PARRALYSIS | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4623010/PARRALYSIS

PARRALYSIS is a First-Person Point-and-Click Indie Horror game that puts the player in the shoes of the main character, paralysed by something growing from inside their body. The only thing they can do is to scribble in a notepad to materialise ingredients for the cure to get out. The player must complete the goal until the time runs out, while defending against abstract threats.

#parralysis
